budgetPacing.detailWithWorst: {monthPct} of the month elapsed · highest usage: {name} ({pct})
budgetPacing.emptyCta: Create budgets by group or category to track your pace.
budgetPacing.how: Share of the total budget already used compared to the share of the month elapsed. The mark on the bar is today.
budgetPacing.label: Budget pace
budgetPacing.overrun: At the current pace, you overrun around day {day}

burnRate.how: Average outflows of the last 3 closed months compared with the last 12 (outflows = expenses + transfers out). A sustained rise is the silent sign of budget erosion.
burnRate.label: Average spend (burn)

cashProjection.event: {account} is projected to go negative around {date}
cashProjection.how: Daily balance projection for your liquid accounts over the next 30 days: today's balance + open transactions by date − your average daily spending from the last 90 days (peaks excluded).
cashProjection.label: Projected balance
cashProjection.method: Considers open bills and your average daily spending
cashProjection.noEvent: No account goes negative in the next {days} days

emergencyRunway.how: Today's total balance divided by your average expenses over the last 6 months. The target adapts to your income volatility: the more irregular, the bigger the recommended cushion.
emergencyRunway.label: Emergency fund

fixedCommitment.emptyCta: Register your fixed bills under Recurring to measure commitment.
fixedCommitment.how: Sum of registered recurring expenses divided by your average monthly income. Reference: keep below 50% (50/30/20 rule).
fixedCommitment.label: Fixed commitment
fixedCommitment.reference: Reference: up to 50% of average income

monthEndForecast.how: Outflows already booked this month (paid and scheduled) + estimated diffuse spending for the remaining days (daily average of the last 90 days, top 10% excluded). The zone compares the projection with your average monthly income.
monthEndForecast.label: Projected month end

overdueCost.how: Overdue unpaid bills, with an estimated late cost: 2% fine + 1% monthly interest, prorated by days late. An estimate — each bill may differ.
overdueCost.label: Overdue bills

personalRunway.basis: Average of the last 6 closed months
personalRunway.growing: No burn — you save at the current pace
personalRunway.how: How many months your balance lasts at the current pace: today's balance ÷ average net burn (outflows − income) over the last 6 months. When you save, there is no burn — the card shows average growth.
personalRunway.label: Cash runway

recurringLoad.emptyCta: Register subscriptions and fixed bills under Recurring.
recurringLoad.how: Sum of registered recurring expenses, monthly and annualized. The annual figure is what reveals the real weight of subscriptions.
recurringLoad.label: Recurring load

safeToSpend.how: Today's balance minus open expenses (pending, scheduled and overdue) due in the next 30 days. Future income is not counted.
safeToSpend.label: Safe to spend

savingsRate.how: How much of your income is left each month: (income − outflows) ÷ income. The line shows the last 12 months.
savingsRate.label: Savings rate

spendingAnomaly.allClearDetail: All groups within their historical median
spendingAnomaly.how: Compares this month's spending in each group with the 12-month median using the median absolute deviation (MAD, threshold 3.5) — a robust method that old spikes can't fool. Only flags spending above the pattern.
spendingAnomaly.label: Month atypicality
